postal_system.assignment_rule: The current Guyana Post Office Corporation finder and August 2025 UPU sheet establish seven numeric digits. The reviewed current GPOC table has 2,272 rows and 214 distinct valid seven-digit codes plus one six-digit anomaly, 120101. Syntax or a table label is not proof of complete current coverage, geometry, a civic address, a building relation or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.geometry_rule: The reviewed GPOC current finder contains no coordinate or geometry field and the UPU sheet publishes no postal boundary. Region, locality, district, sub-locality, street, office, administrative boundary, point, buffer, hull, Voronoi cell, raster, model or AGID cell cannot be presented as official postal geometry. Every source keeps separate assignment authority, geometry authority and reuse rights.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, organization, street, house number, apartment or premises, sub-locality, locality or town, postcode and P.O. Box separately. Preserve current GPOC and UPU field semantics as source-specific because their published digit descriptions are not silently interchangeable.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal object type independently as area, delivery_office, route, po_box, organization, point or unknown. The six-digit GPOC anomaly and UPU P.O. Box example 413018 remain explicit exceptions and must not be padded or forced into an area polygon.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a rights-cleared civic-address identifier and a stable explicit relation to a permitted building identifier and footprint or point. Postcode, street, sub-locality, coordinate, containment or proximity is not an exact address-building relation.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Guyana GeoPortal, Bureau of Statistics and other government identifiers and geometry are contextual only unless an exact competent-authority postcode crosswalk, edition, CRS and compatible rights are pinned. Administrative or statistical geometry is not GPOC postal geometry.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Rights-cleared observations may normalize input, validate or enrich candidates and produce review surfaces with source, service version, request digest, observed_at, generated_at, confidence, uncertainty and official-derived or derived status. They never overwrite evidence or manufacture official geometry.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate typed Guyana assignments, permitted geometry and explicit address-building relations to AGID cells without relabelling a postal object as a grid cell or a grid cell as postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Public GPOC web access is not an explicit processing, derivation, redistribution and public-serving licence. The reviewed GPOC site searches found no applicable open-data terms. UPU POST*CODE data is contract, NDA, annual-fee and data-use-declaration controlled. The Bureau open licence covers Bureau-owned material only and cannot license GPOC or UPU data.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The pack remains ISO GY scope. Postal, administrative, statistical, civic-address, building and AGID identities and authority are independent; no neighbouring or disputed identity is merged.
postal_system.privacy_rule: No raw GPOC rows, exact addresses, customers, recipients, P.O. Boxes, properties, credentials or query logs are bundled. Apply purpose limitation, minimisation, retention, access control and publication review.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Store retrieved_at, observed_at, valid_from, valid_to, release, edition, source version, digest and supersession independently. The current finder page was modified 2025-08-20 and the UPU sheet is edition 08/2025.
postal_system.hugging_face_rule: Publish only rights-cleared versioned Parquet or GeoParquet with source licence, release, schema, CRS, digest and provenance. Restricted GPOC or UPU material remains private, gated or external; production pins immutable commits and verifies digests.

stages.definition: Digest-bound current GPOC, UPU and public government evidence with rights, geometry, typed-object and no-proxy boundaries.

M2 requires a current complete competent-authority release of every Guyana postcode assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and typed area/non-area object, fixed by retrieval time, edition, schema, coverage, exact bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The current reviewed GPOC finder has 2,272 rows, 214 distinct valid seven-digit codes and one six-digit anomaly, 120101, across ten regions, but no geometry fields and no applicable open-data licence located. The August 2025 UPU sheet establishes seven-digit coding and layout evidence while its six-digit P.O. Box example remains a non-area exception; the UPU complete database is contract, NDA, declaration and annual-fee controlled. Every drawable code must reconcile to finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source feature identity, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions. Government administrative/statistical layers, locality or street labels, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, AGID cells and models cannot be promoted without a versioned crosswalk and compatible rights. Delivery-office, route, P.O. Box, organization, point and other non-area objects must show type and reason without a fabricated surface. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real GY API/app, normalize seven digits, handle loading, no-match, multiple, API-failure and invalid-geometry states, fit and render a translucent fill with clear outline only for eligible real geometry, support clear and re-search, and display selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.
